info.title: Autonation Public Contact API
info.description:
Send an appointment request to Autonation Taller Multimarca. Alternative contact: WhatsApp +593 939 057 454 or info@autonation.com.ec. Hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00, Sat 08:00-13:00 (Ecuador local time).

## Versioning and deprecation policy
The canonical endpoint uses /api/v1/...; /api/public/... is a permanent unversioned alias of the latest compatible v1 behavior, with identical behavior and a shared rate limit. Breaking changes will be published as a new path version (/api/v2/...). Removal requires at least 6 months notice. When a version is deprecated, its deprecated operations will send the Deprecation header (RFC 9745) and Sunset header (RFC 8594) and will be marked deprecated: true in this spec. v1 is stable; nothing is deprecated.

post.summary: Send an appointment request (canonical v1 endpoint)
post.description: Sends an appointment-request email to info@autonation.com.ec; it does not create a confirmed booking. JSON body limit: 8 KB. Unknown fields are stripped. Agents MUST OMIT both website and elapsed_ms: these are website anti-bot fields. A non-empty website or elapsed_ms < 2500 returns 200 {"ok":true} without sending anything. Rate limit: 5 requests per hour per IP. Browser CORS allows only https://www.autonation.com.ec and https://autonation.com.ec; server-side agent calls are not affected. Both paths share the same rate limit. Non-POST methods return 405 with Allow: POST, except CORS OPTIONS preflight. Unknown paths under /api/* return typed JSON 404 NOT_FOUND.

example.mensaje: Quisiera solicitar una cita para mantenimiento.

200.description: Request accepted; this is not a confirmed booking.

400.description: Invalid request: INVALID_REQUEST for schema validation failure, INVALID_JSON for malformed JSON, or PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE for a body over 8 KB (also HTTP 400).

example.hint: Los campos nombre y telefono son requeridos. Valores permitidos de marca y servicio en OpenAPI: https://www.autonation.com.ec/openapi.json

405.description: Any non-POST method except the CORS OPTIONS preflight returns HTTP 405.

example.hint: Use POST with a JSON body

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: 5 requests per hour per IP, shared by the canonical path and unversioned alias.

example.error: Demasiados intentos. Intenta mas tarde o escribenos por WhatsApp.
example.hint: Limite de 5 solicitudes por hora por IP. Espera y reintenta o usa WhatsApp +593 939 057 454.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

502.description: Email delivery failed; contact the shop via WhatsApp.

example.error: No se pudo enviar. Escribenos por WhatsApp.
example.hint: Reintenta mas tarde o contactanos por WhatsApp +593 939 057 454.
